output.summary: A perennial herb endemic to the western Mediterranean Basin. Its saxophone-shaped flowers lure small flies, temporarily trapping them before releasing them with pollen. Long-term consumption of its roots or rhizomes can cause irreversible kidney damage, and their aristolochic acids may be carcinogenic when taken internally.
output.edibilityNote: Roots or rhizomes consumed over long periods can cause irreversible kidney damage; internal aristolochic acids may be carcinogenic.
